stories.title: Warren Buffett hands over $1 trillion financial empire to son
stories.summary: Nicknamed the 'Oracle of Omaha,' the 96-year-old magnate renowned for his financial acumen passed the chairmanship of the board of Berkshire Hathaway – the conglomerate he led for 60 years – to his son, Howard Buffett.

kev.name: Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
kev.summary: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.
